title: 8LU - Are we *really* engineers? by Hillel Wayne
summary: Hillel Wayne reports on interviews with 17 people who have worked as both software and traditional engineers. He argues the fields are fundamentally the same and have much to learn from each other.
why: HN uses it as the reference for whether software is really engineering and how it differs from other disciplines.

quote.text: There was a good talk on this subject last week
